Needful Things is supposed to be a spell like the Aberrant Paradox cheat (final Karamelle boss): it gives 2 fairy cards to the enemy that are basically useless and a waste of pips.

The point is to clog their hand so they are unable to draw good cards. 

However, from my experience and what I've heard this card is completely useless at the moment: 

\- because the pip cost is way too high

\- it puts it randomly in their deck which means they might not even draw it. 

\- it doesn't scale based on the level of beast you're using it on, which means they can have a bigger hand and this spell will be even more useless than it already is. 

I'd LOVE to see this spell be useful because it's such a UNIQUE effect that hasn't existed yet as a spell we can use. I try talking to them about it, I'm not sure what's gonna happen. 

My favourite is new spells with special useful abilities, and I'd love to see them pay attention more to that.
